credit.title: Creature, Insect - Dragonfly, Caught in Net (Wing Movement)
credit.author: jaegrover

species: Real recording of a dragonfly's wings buzzing and fluttering, made as it beat its wings in a mist net at a bird-banding station
note: Taken from the Freesound high-quality MP3 preview of the recording. The 200 Hz high-pass removes measured low-frequency rumble and a 100 Hz hum in the background; the wing buzz itself sits above 1 kHz.
